column2: Average Monthly Household Expenditure Among Resident Households by Income Quintile and Type of Dwelling

column4: 2/ It is notable that some resident households in the lowest 20% income group owned a car (13.5%), employed a domestic helper (10.0%), lived in private property (5.7%) or were with household reference persons aged 65 years and over (31.9%) in 2012/13.
